release_notes: Media Experiment Ledger Studio 1.0.0-rc.4 introduces the Hardware Runtime Center. The app now combines Electron GPU and driver inspection with the exact packaged ONNX Runtime inventory, persists explicit provider, device, CPU-fallback and CoreML compute-unit policies, and proves runtime registration, session creation, profiling-based node assignment, fallback behavior and cold/warm latency with a generated local ONNX graph. Detection Studio consumes the same saved production policy, while users can clear provider caches and export a redacted hardware evidence bundle.
features: New Hardware Runtime Center route and responsive desktop UI
Electron GPU adapter, driver, feature status, CPU and memory inspection
Packaged ONNX Runtime provider inventory shown beside desktop GPU evidence
Dependency-free generated ONNX Identity graph for one-click provider self-tests
Separate evidence for registration, session creation, assigned nodes and CPU fallback
Persistent provider, device ID, CPU fallback and CoreML compute-unit preferences
Detection Studio consumes and records the same production hardware policy
Safe provider-cache cleanup and redacted evidence export with SHA-256
Provider planner and engine tests expanded across Windows, Linux and macOS
